 Paris Saint-Germain will be without Maghnes Akliouche and Achraf Hakimi for Saturday's Ligue 1 match against Troyes. Akliouche picked up a calf injury during the 6-0 win over Villarreal in the Champions League and will remain under treatment. He was expected to be called up by France coach Zinedine Zidane for upcoming Nations League matches. Hakimi has been given time off before the international window. PSG said Ousmane Dembele, Marquinhos, and Nuno Mendes have resumed individual training after thigh injuries. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia remains sidelined with a ruptured ACL.

 PARIS (AP) — Paris Saint-Germain will be without Maghnes Akliouche and Achraf Hakimi for Saturday's Ligue 1 match against Troyes.
 The Ligue 1 leaders said in a statement Friday that Akliouche picked up a calf injury during the 6-0 thrashing of Villarreal in the Champions League midweek and will remain under treatment in the coming days. Akliouche was expected to be called up by France coach Zinedine Zidane for upcoming Nations League matches.
